cases.title: A list can be renamed and given a description (trimmed, stored)
An uploaded prospect list can be renamed too
Rename is tenant-isolated (404) and bounded (blank 400, too long 422)
Without manage_prospects a list cannot be renamed (403)
Resending straight away is refused (429, once a minute per user)
After a minute: new temporary password and sign-in link; the old invitation and links are revoked
A second resend within the minute is refused again (429)
Resend guards: joined user 409, other workspace 404, agent 403, admin on a Super Admin invite 403
Reports-to cannot be the user or someone in their own team (400)
Add domain: normalised, stored for this workspace, DNS guidance for SPF / DKIM / DMARC
Unique per workspace (409); another workspace may add the same name (201)
Hostname validation rejects schemes, addresses, IPs, wildcards, spaces and blanks
Only admins add domains (agent 403); any role reads the DNS records
DNS records of another workspace's domain are 404
Check status (diagnostics scan) runs on an added domain and the statuses are refreshed
